definitions.micro_returned_precision_at_3: all relevant top3 hits / all returned top3 hits, including negative queries
definitions.negative_false_positive_rate: negative queries with any top3 result / all negative queries
definitions.conflict: all labeled conflict documents must be present; no first-hit success
definitions.candidate_pool: All positive eligible scores after filters, before top-k; route union is recorded separately by explain()
definitions.history: Evaluator joins prior USER query for retrieval only; no model conversation claim
